claim: The same GitHub-hosted catalog can install the unchanged skill in Claude Code and Codex.
kill_criterion: Either client rejects the catalog, fails to enable the plugin, or caches different skill package content after text newline normalization.
scope: Fresh temporary host profiles; no model inference. Not a measurement of star growth or model behavior.
remote_github_installation: passed for both hosts in fresh temporary profiles

initial_harness_failure.observation: A raw-byte assertion rejected the Claude GitHub installation: 9436 installed bytes versus 9600 workspace bytes. Text was identical after newline normalization.
initial_harness_failure.correction: Compare the complete package after normalizing UTF-8 Markdown/YAML newlines. All other content and filenames remain exact.
initial_harness_failure.negative_controls: A changed text line and a missing metadata file both fail the comparison.
initial_harness_failure.outcome: Both native GitHub installs passed the corrected content invariant.

limitations: GitHub Actions runs portable package tests; native client smoke tests were run locally on Windows.
Native manifest validation reports a nonblocking directory icon advisory; no public-directory submission is claimed.
No effect on star growth has been measured.
